purpose: Crosswalk from supplied fields and narrative domains to the logical model. A mapping is a proposal for where a claim is stored, not a statement that the claim is true.

conventions.raw_claim: Values marked "preserve verbatim" are stored exactly as written (ranges, "~" qualifiers, inch marks, free text). Any parsed helper value is stored beside the raw string, never instead of it.
conventions.identifiers: lopa_id, iata_code and printed row labels are strings even when they look numeric.
conventions.separation: Commercial tier (SeatCommercialAttributes) and physical attributes (SeatPhysicalAttributes: pitch, width, exit, bulkhead, recline, window, legroom, tray, storage, power) are separate; none is inferred from another.

narrative_domains.domain: Configuration summary table (variant, interior generation, totals, tier counts with row ranges, omitted positions)
narrative_domains.notes: Tier cells mix a count with a row/seat range in one string.

narrative_domains.domain: Row numbering rule (labels aligned so overwing exits fall in a fixed label band; skipped labels)
narrative_domains.example_raw_value: Across all 5 active Southwest Airlines cabin configurations (LOPAs), row numbering is standardized so that overwing emergency exits fall in the Row 14–16 band regardless of fuselage length. Every seat maps into three commercial tiers—Extra Legroom (ELR), Preferred, and Standard—with structural cutouts, windowless fuselage frames, and FAA-mandated recline locks varying by interior generation.
narrative_domains.notes: Basis for separating printed label from physical order.

narrative_domains.domain: Row-by-row tier map with pitch statements
narrative_domains.notes: Pitch written with inch marks, ranges and "~".

narrative_domains.example_raw_value: ⚬     Rows 1–6 (Extra Legroom — 36 seats): Full 3-3 layout (A–F) pitched at 35"–36". Row 1 (1A–1F) is a dual-sided bulkhead with armrest-stowed tray tables and zero floor stowage during taxi, takeoff, and landing.

narrative_domains.notes: Includes a shoulder-width statement for a windowless seat.

narrative_domains.domain: Structural deltas between two interior generations (exit-row seats, pitch, last row)

narrative_domains.example_raw_value: ⚬     Row 15 (Extra Legroom — 6 seats): Overwing exit row (15A–15F) pitched at 35"–36". Because 14A is missing, 15A has no seat directly in front of it, providing unobstructed legroom (with an armrest-stowed tray table).

narrative_domains.domain: "As of" date and count of active layouts
narrative_domains.example_raw_value: As of November 13, 2026, Southwest is flying three aircraft families with four active seating layouts because portions of the fleet are still being standardized:
narrative_domains.notes: A date written in the text; not a validation release.

narrative_domains.domain: Layout category table (capacity, arrangement, Extra Legroom pitch, Standard/Preferred pitch, seat width)
narrative_domains.notes: Category grain differs from the registry lopa_id grain; arrangement text names no seats.

narrative_domains.domain: Measurement definition for pitch and "published ranges" attribution
narrative_domains.anchor_quote: Pitch is the distance from a point on one seat
narrative_domains.example_raw_value: The measurements above are Southwest’s published ranges. Pitch is the distance from a point on one seat to the same point on the seat immediately ahead, not the amount of unobstructed knee clearance. [support.so...thwest.com]
narrative_domains.notes: Defines pitch; does not define width.

narrative_domains.domain: Fleet standardisation narrative (upgrade programme, seat products, power, fleet numbers)
narrative_domains.example_raw_value: The 137-seat and 138-seat 737-700 layouts are both in circulation while 170 selected -700s are upgraded. The 138-seat version replaces Innovator seats with Meridian seats, adds in-seat power and converts the affected exit-row position to a triple-seat arrangement. Southwest expects the remaining non-upgraded aircraft to be retired, sold or otherwise removed from the fleet. Changes-and-Upcoming-Additions-to-Our-Fleet.aspx [Changes an...Our Fleet | SharePoint]
narrative_domains.notes: No tail numbers; cannot populate TailAssignment.

narrative_domains.domain: Temporary vs final layout difference for the larger aircraft
narrative_domains.anchor_quote: temporary and final LOPAs both retain 175 total seats
narrative_domains.example_raw_value: The 737-800 and MAX 8 temporary and final LOPAs both retain 175 total seats. The final layout adds one Extra Legroom seat on each side of the exit row, while the last row becomes two seats per side, keeping the overall capacity unchanged. Changes-and-Upcoming-Additions-to-Our-Fleet.aspx [Changes an...Our Fleet | SharePoint]
narrative_domains.notes: Seats are described by area, not by seat code.

narrative_domains.domain: Customer-facing seat tier table (location, physical dimensions, included experience)
narrative_domains.notes: Service inclusions have no logical-model target.

narrative_domains.domain: Seats with Extra Legroom spacing but sold as Preferred (commercial vs physical mismatch) on one layout
narrative_domains.anchor_quote: physically have Extra Legroom spacing but are sold as Preferred
narrative_domains.example_raw_value: On the upgraded 138-seat -700 layout, seats 7D, 7E, 7F, 15B and 15C physically have Extra Legroom spacing but are sold as Preferred, not Extra Legroom. That distinction needs to be retained in any configuration, seat-map or appearance-part application because the physical pitch and commercial product designation do not match. Changes-and-Upcoming-Additions-to-Our-Fleet.aspx [Changes an...Our Fleet | SharePoint]
narrative_domains.notes: Applies only to the layout the DOCX names; that layout has no seat set in the registry.

narrative_domains.example_raw_value: Premium access by fare and loyalty tier
narrative_domains.notes: Commercial policy; outside cabin-appearance scope. Kept as source text only.

narrative_domains.example_raw_value: The 737 MAX 7 is not yet a current revenue configuration. Recent Tech Ops communication identifies a planned 150-passenger ELR/RECARO layout, with initial revenue service targeted for 2027 and dates subject to change. Know Before Fix | 737 MAX-7 vs MAX-8 Differences [Know Befor...ifferences | Outlook]
narrative_domains.notes: Planned, date subject to change; no registry record.
